label: post_hoc_uiux03
description: Relevance grades for records returned by the SPECIALIST-UIUX-03 candidate that neither the frozen judgments in cases.json, post-hoc-judgments.json nor the SPECIALIST-UIUX-02 experiment judgments cover. Assigned by the Builder Agent after inspecting each catalog record and after seeing the candidate output, so they are weaker evidence than frozen judgments. In SPECIALIST-UIUX-03 all 17 cases are development and regression evidence, including the formerly reserved SYN-04, SYN-07 and SYN-11. The SYN-11 entry was returned by a pre-freeze iteration before the colour/colours query alias, not by the frozen candidate; it is retained as recorded. Grades of 0 are given only where the record content does not fit the task. Conflicts are not judged here; they come from the frozen conflict rules.
